# Sam Davis

> Sam Davis is a UK iOS developer, iOS Team Lead at 3 Sided Cube, who also makes independent apps. This site hosts the pages for those apps.

## Apps

- [Points](https://samapps.co.uk/points/): An iPhone app for finding Virgin Atlantic reward seats worth spending Virgin Points on.

## Points

Points (listed on the App Store as "Points: reward seat finder") tracks Virgin Atlantic reward seat prices for every cabin, on every route, for every day of the 11-month booking window. It's free to download from the App Store, for iOS 26 and later, with optional Points Plus subscription features (below): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759494927

- Saver seats are marked with a little red tag.
- One-way and round-trip search, with trip length in nights.
- Save flights and trips to come back to.
- Price history charts: 1 or 2 weeks free, up to 11 months with Points Plus.
- Points Plus (a monthly subscription, £4.49 / $4.49) adds price alerts (when a price drops, rises, or a saver seat appears), the full 11 months of price history, and natural-language search.
- Made by one person, Sam Davis. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Virgin Atlantic.
